limitations: NOT_PG_EXECUTED: exact Knex/PostgreSQL rendering remains to be checked against the fixed expectations; never learn a replacement from observations.
Only five queue-relevant public tables have physical expectations. Full DB content belongs to the independent complete-database verifier.
Exact source has 3 webhooks migrations; a fourth is NOT fabricated.
No native PG driver/psql executor, authenticated store transport, credentials, producer barrier, or cross-store atomic snapshot.
Redis DB0 keys outside these exact queues reject until a separately reviewed sessions/cache/subscriptions contract exists.
Other Redis databases and independent n8n execution queues must be gated separately; no empty Speckle result qualifies n8n.
Offline admission is not trusted runtime evidence or a recovered/qualified deployment.

postgres.drainPolicy: Block all nonterminal, failed, malformed, exhausted, unknown or foreign-origin/type jobs; successful terminal rows permitted.

redis.policy: Conservative empty-only: all job/state/lock/debounce/limiter artifacts block, including terminal retention. No repairs. id and live stalled-check are the only inert artifacts. Nonqueue key admission is deliberately absent; unknown DB0 keys reject.
